[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
James is named as the son of Robert and Apphia (Moores) Glasgow in an 1837 court notice in the Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser.<ref>Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser, Friday, 23 June 1837,  Volume 87, Issue 14465, Page 4, Column 5. Image found on {{FindAGrave|105585399|sameas="no"}}</ref> The notice says that James had died, leaving these children:

* Susanna Pannell Glasgow, adult
* James Glasgow, minor
* Deliverance Hanna Glasgow, minor
* George Robert Glasgow, minor

(Based on the dates for the children, they may have been minors at the time of death but were adults by the time of that newspaper notice.)
